answer.reason: Genesis tells of Hagar's flight from Sarai, her expulsion with her son, and God's provision of a well, none of which the summary states.

clauses.english: fled from Sarai and was found by the angel of the LORD in the wilderness
clauses.quote: I flee from the face of my mistress Sarai

clauses.english: was sent away by Abraham and wandered in the wilderness
clauses.quote: and she departed, and wandered in the wilderness of Beersheba

clauses.english: had her eyes opened by God to see a well of water
clauses.quote: God opened her eyes, and she saw a well of water

doubts: GAL 4:24-25 (Agar) is an allegory about covenants, not an event, so it was left out.
Her bearing Ishmael is already in the summary as motherhood, so it was not made a clause.
